svg.title: TimeOptimalSphereGame finite-catalogue minimax reachability
svg.desc: Convex-hull envelopes of each finite forward layer and its backward-winning intersection, the unit-disk target, and a worst-case trajectory under the causal minimax policy.
svg.text: TimeOptimalSphereGame: guaranteed capture under an adversarial input
Finite catalogues u,v ∈ {−1,0,1} · sequential response (v observes u) · capture by 35 decisions · worst-case 3.43 s
faint filled envelopes: forward finite-state layers (color marks stage)
green: worst-case path under a causal minimax-optimal policy
yellow: unit-disk target; start and capture are marked
Polygons are display-only convex-hull envelopes of exact finite nodes; full nodes and winning intersections are in figure-data.json. No continuous-boundary claim.
